:::{#def-question}
#### Question

Let $X$ be a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv),
and let $\srcalph$ be the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) of its [values](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-realization)
with positive [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability).
A **question** about $X$ is a [collection](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-collection)
of nonempty, [disjoint](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-mutually-exclusive) [subsets](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-subset) of $\srcalph$
whose [union](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-union) is $\srcalph$.

:::
